title: Human Resources, Knowledge Management Specialist
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward\-thinking, and experienced Human Resources Service Excellence, Knowledge Management Specialist who will be responsible for delivering results against some of the most complex business and technology initiatives.
   

  

 This role will be a full\-time position based out of IND\- Coimbatore. If you are passionate about solving complex challenges and driving innovation – let’s talk!
   

  

 Our organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 Responsible for overseeing the creation, distribution, utilization and management of Avantor’s business processes and information. The Service Excellence Specialist in Knowledge Management is responsible for ensuring the effective management and utilization of knowledge resources to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency. This role involves analyzing service processes, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing knowledge management strategies to support organizational goals.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Assist in HR Knowledge Management activities within the Service Excellence team.
* Help update and maintain HR knowledge content such as FAQs, procedures, and basic training materials.
* Ensure information is accurate, up\-to\-date, and easy to access.
* Follow given guidelines for creating and maintaining content.
* Support routine checks to keep content relevant.
* Work with team members to update and organize knowledge base content.
* Collect information from different sources as guided.
* Ensure work follows company policies and standards.
* Basic awareness of knowledge management tools and practices.
* Good communication skills in English (written and spoken); knowledge of another regional language is added advantage.


**Experience**
* 1\+ years of relevant experience in HR Knowledge Management, Information Management, or a similar role.
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Proficiency in using Knowledge Management systems and data analysis tools.
* Proven experience in analyzing, structuring, and transferring organization's knowledge effectively.
* Hands\-on experience in creating, updating, and maintaining knowledge bases and conducting relevant quality checks.
* Experience in Knowledge Management role within HR or HR shared service environment.
* Familiarity with knowledge management principles, best practices, and industry trends Workday, Service Now proficiency.


**Disclaimer**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Why Avantor?**
**Dare to go further in your career.** 
 Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.
   

  

**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** 
 It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
   

  

 We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world.
 **Apply today!**

We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/province, or local law.

Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. title: Technical Engineer
description:
Job Title: Technical Engineer
   

  

 Location: Tambaram , Chengalpattu, Avadi, Tiruvannamalai, Vellore, Erode , Tirupur, Coimbatore
   

  

 Experience: 0\-1 years
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Handle assigned IoT projects from planning to execution and ensure timely completion.
* Coordinate and follow up on complete project status with customers, field teams, service teams, and internal technical teams.
* Attend installation and service activities for IoT controllers at customer locations.
* Monitor ongoing IoT projects and provide daily project updates to management and concerned teams.
* Coordinate with installation and service teams for timely completion of field activities.
* Maintain proper documentation for installation reports, service reports, site updates, customer feedback, site photos, and project completion records.
* Identify repeated technical issues reported from field sites and update the same to the R\&D team for analysis.
* Work closely with the R\&D team to identify root causes and support corrective actions.
* Ensure all project\-related issues are followed up until proper closure.
* Support troubleshooting, testing, and corrective actions during installation and service.


**Qualification**
 Diploma / Degree in EEE, ECE, E\&I, Mechatronics, or any related technical field will be preferred.
   

  

 Candidates with any degree may also apply, provided they have interest in technical field work, IoT projects, and customer site coordination.
   

  

**Experience**
 Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
   

  

 Experience in IoT projects, installation, service, field support, electronics, electrical maintenance, or project coordination will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher
   

  

 Pay: ₹15,000\.00 – ₹25,000\.00 per month
   

  

**Benefits**
* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund


**Supplemental Pay**
* Overtime pay
* Performance bonus
* Shift allowance
* Yearly bonus


**Education**
 Bachelor’s (Preferred)
   

  

**Experience**
 Total work: 1 year (Preferred)
   

  

 Work Location: In person

title: Senior Engineer – Continuous Improvement
description:
* The Senior Engineer of TBS will act as a primary catalyst for operational excellence, specifically supporting lean initiatives across our transactional processes. This role is critical in championing the standard design and global deployment of the Texmo Business System (TBS), ensuring that TBS frameworks are seamlessly integrated into the organization's daily operations and quality management standards.
* Kaizen \& Transactional Process Improvement (TPI):
+ Support strategic planning, facilitation, and execution of transactional process improvement (TPI) Kaizen events.
+ Monitor post\-event progress, proactively identifying and escalating deviations to ensure sustained results.
+ Mentor and handhold cross\-functional Kaizen teams, coaching them effectively on TBS tools and techniques.
+ Support organizational problem solving using A3 methodology.
+ Enhance daily management and problem solving at transactional processes.


**TBS Governance \& Global Deployment**
* Drive and support the standardized deployment of the Texmo Business System across global locations.
* Maintain TBS standards and processes as per the defined structure and place accessible easily and update on regular intervals.


**TBS\-QMS Integration**
* Bridge the gap between continuous improvement and quality assurance by accurately translating TBS documents and processes into Quality Management System (QMS) language.
* Upkeep the document master and ensure rigorous version control across all platforms.


* Qualifications \& Expertise:


**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 A minimum of 7 to 10 years of progressive experience focused on continuous improvement, TPI processes, and QMS.
   

  

**Technical Proficiencies**
* Expert\-level knowledge of Lean methodologies and project management lifecycles.
* Strong proficiency in advanced process mapping techniques, specifically Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and Makigami.
* Practical, hands\-on experience utilizing statistical analysis software such as Minitab and JMP.
* High proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools including MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Exceptional facilitative and influencing skills, with a proven ability to lead and drive change within a matrixed, cross\-functional environment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Superior communication and presentation skills, demonstrating the ability to distill and convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
